name: @rhythmjs/queue
description: Typed job queues for Rhythm on Bun: a queue module on the kernel with a typed job map, named processors, repeatable schedules, and lifecycle-managed workers — an in-memory engine by default, Bun's native redis client for distribution.

scripts.build: bun build src/queue.ts src/types.ts --outdir dist --root src --format esm --target bun --packages external --splitting && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
